@@ -0,0 +1,298 @@
+import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  QueryCache,
+  QueryClient,
+  QueryObserver,
+  createPersisterRestoreResult,
+  isPersisterRestoreResult,
+  reconcileQueryState,
+} from '..'
+import { queryKey, sleep } from '@tanstack/query-test-utils'
+import type { QueryState } from '..'
+
+describe('createPersisterRestoreResult & reconcileQueryState', () => {
+  test('createPersisterRestoreResult creates a valid restore marker', () => {
+    const state: Partial<QueryState<string, Error>> = {
+      data: 'persisted data',
+      status: 'success',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 12345,
+    }
+    const result = createPersisterRestoreResult({
+      data: 'persisted data',
+      state,
+    })
+
+    expect(result.data).toBe('persisted data')
+    expect(result.state).toMatchObject(state)
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult(result)).toBe(true)
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult({ data: 'foo' })).toBe(false)
+    expect(isPersisterRestoreResult(null)).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('reconcileQueryState independently merges live newer data and persisted newer error', () => {
+    const liveError = new Error('live error')
+    const persistedError = new Error('persisted error')
+
+    const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'live-newer-data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 500,
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      error: liveError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 100,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureReason: liveError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted-older-data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 200,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 600,
+      errorUpdateCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureCount: 3,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const merged = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+    // Data should be taken from live (500 > 200)
+    expect(merged.data).toBe('live-newer-data')
+    expect(merged.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(500)
+    expect(merged.dataUpdateCount).toBe(2)
+
+    // Error should be taken from persisted (600 > 100)
+    expect(merged.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(merged.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(600)
+    expect(merged.errorUpdateCount).toBe(2)
+    expect(merged.fetchFailureCount).toBe(3)
+    expect(merged.fetchFailureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+
+    // Status is 'error' because error is non-null
+    expect(merged.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(merged.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(merged.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  test('reconcileQueryState independently merges persisted newer data and live newer error (inverse rule)', () => {
+    const liveError = new Error('live error')
+    const persistedError = new Error('persisted error')
+
+    const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'live-older-data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 200,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error: liveError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 600,
+      errorUpdateCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureCount: 4,
+      fetchFailureReason: liveError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted-newer-data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 500,
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 100,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const merged = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+    // Data should be taken from persisted (500 > 200), NOT discarded despite live newer error
+    expect(merged.data).toBe('persisted-newer-data')
+    expect(merged.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(500)
+
+    // Error should be taken from live (600 > 100)
+    expect(merged.error).toBe(liveError)
+    expect(merged.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(600)
+    expect(merged.fetchFailureCount).toBe(4)
+    expect(merged.fetchFailureReason).toBe(liveError)
+
+    expect(merged.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(merged.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+  })
+
+  test('restoring via persister option does not trigger onSuccess callbacks and preserves error state and counters', async () => {
+    const onSuccessSpy = vi.fn()
+    const onSettledSpy = vi.fn()
+    const queryCache = new QueryCache({
+      onSuccess: onSuccessSpy,
+      onSettled: onSettledSpy,
+    })
+    const client = new QueryClient({ queryCache })
+    const key = queryKey()
+
+    const persistedError = new Error('network failed during refetch')
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'cached data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error: persistedError,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureCount: 3,
+      fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persister = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() =>
+      createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: 'cached data',
+        state: persistedState,
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const queryFn = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue('fresh server data')
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(client, {
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn,
+      persister,
+    })
+
+    const unsubscribe = observer.subscribe(() => {})
+
+    await sleep(10)
+
+    expect(persister).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(queryFn).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSuccessSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSettledSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+
+    const currentResult = observer.getCurrentResult()
+    expect(currentResult.data).toBe('cached data')
+    expect(currentResult.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(currentResult.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(currentResult.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+    expect(currentResult.isError).toBe(true)
+    expect(currentResult.isSuccess).toBe(false)
+    expect(currentResult.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    expect(currentResult.failureCount).toBe(3)
+    expect(currentResult.failureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(currentResult.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(1000)
+    expect(currentResult.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+    expect(currentResult.isStale).toBe(true)
+
+    unsubscribe()
+  })
+
+  test('restoring via persister preserves infinite query pagination state', async () => {
+    const client = new QueryClient()
+    const key = queryKey()
+
+    const infiniteData = {
+      pages: ['page 1', 'page 2', 'page 3'],
+      pageParams: [undefined, 1, 2],
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: QueryState<typeof infiniteData, Error> = {
+      data: infiniteData,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 3,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      errorUpdateCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureCount: 0,
+      fetchFailureReason: null,
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      isInvalidated: false,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persister = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() =>
+      createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: infiniteData,
+        state: persistedState,
+      }),
+    )
+
+    await client.prefetchInfiniteQuery({
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn: () => infiniteData,
+      initialPageParam: 0,
+      getNextPageParam: () => 1,
+      persister: persister as any,
+    })
+
+    const query = client.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey: key })
+    expect(query).toBeDefined()
+    expect(query?.state.data).toEqual(infiniteData)
+    expect(query?.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+  })
+
+  test('restored observer results preserve failure count and timestamps during optimistic mount', () => {
+    const client = new QueryClient()
+    const key = queryKey()
+
+    const persistedError = new Error('persisted refetch error')
+    const query = client.getQueryCache().build(
+      client,
+      { queryKey: key },
+      {
+        data: 'cached data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1111,
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        error: persistedError,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 2222,
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureCount: 5,
+        fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: true,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      },
+    )
+
+    expect(query.state.fetchFailureCount).toBe(5)
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(client, {
+      queryKey: key,
+      queryFn: () => 'fresh',
+      _optimisticResults: 'optimistic',
+    })
+
+    const initialResult = observer.getOptimisticResult(
+      client.defaultQueryOptions({
+        queryKey: key,
+        queryFn: () => 'fresh',
+        _optimisticResults: 'optimistic',
+      }),
+    )
+
+    // During mount, failure count, error, and timestamps must reflect persisted snapshot
+    expect(initialResult.failureCount).toBe(5)
+    expect(initialResult.failureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(initialResult.error).toBe(persistedError)
+    expect(initialResult.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(initialResult.data).toBe('cached data')
+    expect(initialResult.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(1111)
+    expect(initialResult.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2222)
+    expect(initialResult.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+  })
+})

@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+import type { DefaultError, QueryStatus } from './types'
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+
+export const PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL: unique symbol = Symbol(
+  'persisterRestoreResult',
+)
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+  readonly [PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL]: true
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(
+  restore: {
+    data?: TData
+    state?: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>> | Partial<QueryState<any, any>>
+  },
+): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  const data = restore.data !== undefined ? restore.data : restore.state?.data
+  const state = restore.state ? { ...restore.state } : {}
+  if (data !== undefined && state.data === undefined) {
+    state.data = data
+  }
+  return {
+    data,
+    state,
+    [PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL]: true,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (value as any)[PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL] === true
+  )
+}
+
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  liveState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  persistedState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  // 1. Data freshness
+  const liveHasData = liveState.data !== undefined
+  const persistedHasData = persistedState.data !== undefined
+
+  let usePersistedData = false
+  if (persistedHasData && !liveHasData) {
+    usePersistedData = true
+  } else if (persistedHasData && liveHasData) {
+    usePersistedData =
+      (persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0) > (liveState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+  }
+
+  const data = usePersistedData ? persistedState.data : liveState.data
+  const dataUpdatedAt = usePersistedData
+    ? persistedState.dataUpdatedAt
+    : liveState.dataUpdatedAt
+  const dataUpdateCount = usePersistedData
+    ? persistedState.dataUpdateCount
+    : liveState.dataUpdateCount
+
+  // 2. Error freshness
+  const liveHasError = liveState.error != null
+  const persistedHasError = persistedState.error != null
+
+  let usePersistedError = false
+  if (persistedHasError && !liveHasError) {
+    usePersistedError = true
+  } else if (persistedHasError && liveHasError) {
+    usePersistedError =
+      (persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0) > (liveState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0)
+  }
+
+  const error = usePersistedError ? persistedState.error : liveState.error
+  const errorUpdatedAt = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedState.errorUpdatedAt
+    : liveState.errorUpdatedAt
+  const errorUpdateCount = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedState.errorUpdateCount
+    : liveState.errorUpdateCount
+  const fetchFailureCount = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedState.fetchFailureCount
+    : liveState.fetchFailureCount
+  const fetchFailureReason = usePersistedError
+    ? persistedState.fetchFailureReason
+    : liveState.fetchFailureReason
+
+  // 3. Status
+  let status: QueryStatus
+  if (error != null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (data !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status =
+      (usePersistedError ? persistedState.status : liveState.status) ??
+      'pending'
+  }
+
+  // 4. Invalidation
+  const isInvalidated =
+    Boolean(liveState.isInvalidated) || Boolean(persistedState.isInvalidated)
+
+  return {
+    data,
+    dataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount,
+    error,
+    errorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason,
+    fetchMeta: null,
+    isInvalidated,
+    status,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+  }
+}
